verdict.rationale: An AI-training opt-out or no-training commitment is a fair privacy-posture question for any cloud-synced consumer service like Authy, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack addresses AI model training, data-use opt-outs, or a no-training policy. Encrypted backups (authy-docs-5, authy-docs-18) are an adjacent security control, not a training-data opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
